name: ICMR Post-Doctoral Fellowship (ICMR-PDF)
funder: Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), Government of India
amount: Rs 65,000/month consolidated + HRA + Rs 3 lakh/year contingency
other_rules: Indian nationals only (those abroad considered in absentia)
PhD awarded within 3 years of the deadline
maximum age 32 (relaxable 5 years for SC/ST/OBC/PH and women)
proposed work must continue the PhD research
PDF guide must be Scientist-C or above
notes: Last call on the ICMR page was 1-28 Feb 2023; no newer call is posted, so treat these dates as stale. Apply through the host institution with director recommendation; hard copy plus soft copy to pdfhrd.icmr@gmail.com. Selection by interview at ICMR HQ. Two referee testimonials (one from PhD guide) and an RIO-verified plagiarism report needed.

documents.name: Research proposal
documents.notes: Detailed proposal continuing the PhD work

documents.name: Referee testimonials
documents.notes: Two, one from the PhD guide

documents.notes: Verified by ICMR Research Integrity Officer
